screens.title: Commerce settings
screens.subtitle: How Commerce behaves for this workspace

blocks.footer: A site can override these on its own plugin page.

fields.label: Maximum register discount (%)
fields.help: The largest discount the point of sale will accept on a sale. A register that asks for more is refused, and the sale is not rung up. Set to 0 to stop staff discounting at the register entirely. Between 0 and 100.

fields.label: Take cards offline in the point of sale app
fields.help: With no connection, the app’s card reader saves each card and charges it once back online.

fields.label: Limit per sale ($)
fields.help: Empty: up to $10,000, the most one card can be charged offline. Between 1 and 10000.

fields.label: Daily limit per device ($)
fields.help: Empty: no daily limit. Between 1 and 1000000.

fields.label: Ask for tips at the register
fields.help: Offers the customer a tip on the card reader and on the customer display. Tips are yours: they are not counted as sales and carry no platform fee.

fields.label: Tip choices (%)
fields.help: Up to four percentages, separated by commas, shown to the customer as tip buttons. The customer can also enter an amount or choose no tip.

fields.label: Receipts at the register
fields.help: With a customer display paired, "Ask the customer" lets them choose email, print or no receipt on their own screen.

fields.label: Customer display welcome
fields.help: The line the customer display shows under your store name between sales. Leave blank for "Welcome".

fields.label: Offer email sign-up on the customer display
fields.help: Shows an unticked "Email me news and offers" box when a customer asks for an email receipt. Only a ticked box adds them to your marketing audience.

fields.label: Require an open shift to sell
fields.help: A register refuses sales and cash refunds until someone opens a shift with a starting float, so every sale is counted in a drawer.

fields.label: Cashier refund limit ($)
fields.help: The largest return a cashier may refund at the register without a manager entering their PIN. Workspace admins have no limit. Set to 0 to have a manager approve every register refund. Between 0 and 100000.

fields.label: Lock the register after (minutes idle)
fields.help: After this many minutes without a tap the register locks and asks for a staff PIN. Set to 0 to never lock. Between 0 and 240.

fields.label: Address on printed receipts
fields.help: Printed under your store name. Put each line on its own line.

fields.label: Return policy on printed receipts
fields.help: Printed at the foot of every receipt and gift receipt.

fields.label: Kiosk: let customers pay at the counter
fields.help: Adds "Pay at counter" to the self-service kiosk. The order goes to the register’s queue with its number, and a cashier takes payment there.

fields.label: Kiosk: start over after (seconds idle)
fields.help: After this long without a touch the kiosk asks "Still there?", then clears the cart and anything the customer typed. Between 30 and 600.

fields.label: Kiosk welcome
fields.help: The line the kiosk’s start screen shows under your store name. Leave blank for "Order here".
